freeze.amendment_policy: Any change requires a new manifest_id and higher protocol revision before any future-holdout access; retain this manifest and explain the delta.

scope.claim_target: CE density-boundary to fixed BAO forward-model bridge
excluded_claims: a CE-internal recombination or nuclear-physics derivation
scope.interpretation: A rejection kills the registered cosmology bridge candidate, not the CE core.

exploratory_or_calibration.provenance: CobayaSampler/bao_data desi_bao_dr2 Gaussian BAO mean/covariance ASCII, embedded as 13 points and a 13x13 covariance matrix.
exploratory_or_calibration.why_not_holdout: DESI DR2 was inspected and used for residual and sound-horizon scale diagnosis before this manifest; it cannot be relabelled as untouched future evidence.
exploratory_or_calibration.raw_release_hash_status: No standalone raw release artifact is stored in this repository snapshot.
permitted_uses: regression testing of the embedded vector

qualification_criteria: A public, versioned BAO likelihood or numerical data vector is released after 2026-08-02.
The release provides the full covariance and an unambiguous observable and redshift-bin definition.
No maintainer involved in model or threshold design has inspected the numerical holdout values before assignment.
The release is not a repackaging or relabelling of the DESI DR2 13-point vector already used here.
Any sample overlap with exploratory data is declared before evaluation and handled by a frozen joint-covariance rule.
selection_policy.disqualification_rule: If the first release fails any criterion, record the reason without viewing additional numerical values and consider the next chronological release.

fit_policy.nuisance_parameter_policy: No nuisance parameter may be fit on holdout data. Any unavoidable release-defined nuisance treatment must be fixed by the data producer and copied verbatim into the assignment manifest before access.

numeric_tolerances.name: covariance_symmetry_absolute_error
numeric_tolerances.scope: Maximum absolute C_ij-C_ji before likelihood evaluation

numeric_tolerances.name: distance_integration_relative_error
numeric_tolerances.scope: Registered BAO distance observables under grid refinement

numeric_tolerances.name: early_sound_horizon_relative_error
numeric_tolerances.scope: Eisenstein-Hu hybrid r_d under permitted numerical grid refinement only

acceptance_criteria.multiplicity_policy: Both registered candidates are evaluated and reported as separate fixed bridge candidates; no winner is selected after unblinding.
acceptance_criteria.interpretation: PASS means this goodness-of-fit gate did not reject the fixed candidate. It is not a posterior probability that CE is true.

hard_kill_rules.condition: A registered candidate has full-covariance fixed-model p < 0.0027 with zero parameters fit on the holdout.
hard_kill_rules.action: Mark that registered cosmology bridge candidate REJECTED and do not rescue it by rescaling H0*rd or changing bins.
hard_kill_rules.target: The failing registered density-boundary BAO bridge candidate, not the CE core.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The manifest digest, an input artifact digest, or the assigned holdout digest does not match.
hard_kill_rules.action: Invalidate the evaluation and require a documented higher-revision manifest before any rerun.

hard_kill_rules.condition: Any forbidden parameter, covariance element, redshift bin, observable, error scale, or candidate choice is adjusted after holdout access.
hard_kill_rules.action: Invalidate the confirmatory evaluation; any result may be reported only as exploratory.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The full released covariance is unavailable, altered, or replaced by a diagonal approximation.
hard_kill_rules.action: Do not issue PASS, TENSION, or REJECT from the future-holdout gate.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The future dataset is accessed before its identifier, release, URI, and checksum are frozen in a higher-revision assignment manifest.
hard_kill_rules.action: Classify the accessed dataset as exploratory forever and allocate a new future holdout.

hard_kill_rules.condition: DESI DR2 or another already inspected vector is assigned as the future holdout.
hard_kill_rules.action: Reject the assignment without evaluating it as confirmatory evidence.
